relationshipPatch is optional and contains only claims (at most 24), events (at most 12), and retire (at most 24), each an array. An empty patch is {"claims":[],"events":[],"retire":[]}.
claims: {id?,expectedVersion?,subject,aspect,text,assertionKind,epistemicStatus,lifecycle?,validFrom?,validUntil?,context?,sourceIds,topicKeys?}. subject=self|contact|dyad; aspect=interest|recent_context|stated_preference|boundary|mutual_knowledge|coordination|relationship_intent|interaction_hypothesis; assertionKind=stated|reported|observed|inferred; epistemicStatus=supported|tentative|contested|undetermined; lifecycle=active|superseded|withdrawn (default active). Inferred claims must remain tentative, contested, or undetermined, never supported. observed requires actual QQ evidence; a private report of an event uses reported. stated means someone said it, not independent proof; contact+stated requires an actual incoming QQ source and only that contact evidence determines its date, not a user's later question. A user's interpretation or retelling of her words must be reported/inferred, never her stated feeling. Unknowns are not personality traits. stated_preference does not authorize changing user preferences.
events: {id?,expectedVersion?,activityKey,eventKind,actor,text,occurredAt?,sourceIds,topicKeys?}. eventKind=invitation|acceptance|decline|reschedule|cancellation|occurred|interest_expression|boundary|sharing; actor=self|contact|both|unknown. activityKey is a short, stable label for the same activity (up to 120 characters), not a relationship stage; use a new label for a genuinely new activity. Distinguish invitation, acceptance, reschedule, cancellation and occurred. A copied draft is none of these actual actions. User-reported activities stay reported; do not invent actual QQ messages.
retire: {id,expectedVersion,sourceIds,lifecycle: superseded|withdrawn}. Existing update ids come only from supplied typed claims/events. In background memory, retirement may also name an offered priorMemory.items legacy item. Always copy the supplied version as expectedVersion, including retire. Omit id and expectedVersion for new records. Each sourceIds array has 1..64 supplied live source references, never generated artifacts, summaries or other claims; topicKeys has at most 8 nonempty terms of at most 80 characters. text is nonempty and at most 1000 characters; context at most 500. Optional times must be ISO dates/datetimes and validFrom<=validUntil; omit unknown time rather than inventing it. Relative time such as this week or Friday is anchored to the original source at, never silently rolled forward to the current week. If the source crossed a week boundary or its wording conflicts with its date, retain the original date and the unknown range. validFrom alone does not establish current applicability or an unlimited duration. Set validUntil only with source support. For a concrete arrangement, confirm whether it still applies; a conditional next step is allowed without guessing an upcoming Friday. Do not output scope, version, sourceRevisions, origin, evidenceValidity, authority, goal or permissions; the program owns them. Omitted fields and omitted records are not deletions. Preserve useful existing records, update only when new evidence matters, and explicitly retire contradictory old interpretations with new evidence.
